verses.1: And they took Yehohachaz, the son of Josiah, and made him king in place of his father in Jerusalem.
verses.2: At the age of thirty-six, he became king. For three years, he ruled in Jerusalem.
verses.3: And he removed him from being king of Egypt in Jerusalem. He also punished the land with a fine of one hundred talents of silver and gold.
verses.4: And the king of Egypt put his brothers, Eljakim and Yerushalayim, in power over the Jews. He also took away their names: Yehoyakim and Yoahaz. Then he brought them back from Egypt.
verses.5: At the age of forty-five, Jehoiakim became king. He ruled for twelve years in Jerusalem. But he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, his God.
verses.6: Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, was put on that throne. But he was prohibited from being executed in Babylon.
verses.7: And from all of the things in the house of Jehovah, Nebuchadnezzar brought them to Babylon. He placed them in his palace in Babylon.
verses.8: And all the words and deeds of Jehoiakim, which he did, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah. Jehoiakim was his son’s king.
verses.9: He ruled for three years in Jerusalem. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.10: And at the beginning of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar sent him with all the gifts that belonged to the House of God. He then became king over Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.11: At the age of forty-one, he became king. He ruled for eleven years in Jerusalem.
verses.12: And he did evil in the eyes of Jehovah, his God. He did not submit to Jeremiah, the prophet, before Jehovah.
verses.13: And also, King Nebuchadnezzar rebelled against God. He cut off his hair and renounced his own heart, in order to return to Jehovah, the God of Israel.
verses.14: And all the priests and the people also became arrogant, more so than all the other nations. They profaned the House of God that was sanctified in Jerusalem.
verses.15: And Jehovah, the God of their fathers, sent upon them the plagues of His wrath. He sent them as a punishment for their sins.
verses.16: And they became slanderers among the people of God, and they spoke falsely about His words. They were also confused by His ways, until they reached the boiling point of Jehovah’s anger in their own nation.
verses.17: And he sent the king of the Chaldeans against them. They killed many of them in their own homes, in their temples. He didn’t show any mercy towards those who were old or weak. He destroyed everything in his power.
verses.18: And all the utensils of the great and small things of the Temple of God, as well as the treasures of the Temple of Jehovah and those of the king and his ministers, all of them were brought by the flood.
verses.19: And they burned down the temple of God. They also destroyed the houses of Jerusalem and all its palaces. All the buildings in Jerusalem were set ablaze so that they could be destroyed.
verses.20: And Shearithel was brought back from the underworld to Babylon. She and her children became servants to King Persia.
verses.21: To fulfill the words of Jehovah through Jeremiah’s mouth, until the earth rest in its Sabbath days. Every day of the Sabbath, it rested for seventy years.
verses.22: And in one year, Korash, king of Persia, spread the words of Jehovah through Jeremiah. Jehovah blessed Korash, king of Persia. His voice spread throughout all his kingdom, and it was also recorded in writing as follows:
verses.23: Thus said Koresh, king of Persia: “All the kings of the earth have given me these things from Jehovah, the God of heaven. He has commanded me to build a house for Him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. From every nation of the world, Jehovah, my God, will be with me.”
